transcript.content: Hello, I am Dr. Smith. Could you please tell me what brings you in to see me today?
I've been feeling incredibly depressed and sad lately, and it's been going on for about three months now. I just feel constantly down and can't seem to shake this heavy feeling.
Have you ever experienced periods lasting several days where you felt unusually energetic, talkative, or needed much less sleep than normal?
No, I've never experienced anything like that at all. It has actually been the complete opposite for me—I just feel constantly exhausted, deeply depressed, and completely lacking any motivation.
Have you felt this way most of the day, nearly every day, for at least two years, or has this been a more recent change in your mood?

No, it hasn't been going on for two years. This is a more recent change for me, and I've only been feeling this heavy and depressed for about three months. It seemed to start quite suddenly and just hasn't let up since then.
During these past three months, have you lost interest or pleasure in activities that you used to enjoy?
Yes, completely. I've lost all interest in the things I used to love doing, and absolutely nothing brings me joy or pleasure anymore. Everything just feels completely pointless and empty.
Have you noticed any significant changes in your appetite or your sleep patterns, such as sleeping much more or less than usual?
To be honest, I haven't noticed any major changes in my appetite or how much I sleep. They both seem pretty much the same as they've always been.
Have you been struggling with feelings of worthlessness, excessive guilt, or difficulty concentrating on your daily tasks?

I haven't really struggled with feelings of worthlessness, guilt, or trouble concentrating. It's more that I just have absolutely no motivation to do anything because of this persistent sadness. I just feel so heavy and down all the time.
Did anything significant or stressful happen in your life about three months ago that might have triggered these feelings?

Yes, these feelings definitely started about three months ago. But looking back, I really can't think of any specific stressful event or trigger that happened at that time to cause this. It just seemed to come out of nowhere.
Have you noticed that your movements or speech have become noticeably slower, or conversely, have you felt physically restless and unable to sit still?

Yes, I've actually noticed both of those things happening. Sometimes I feel incredibly restless, like I can't sit still and just have to pace around, but other times I feel completely slowed down and it takes a huge effort just to move or speak.
Given how heavy and hopeless you have been feeling, have you had any thoughts about harming yourself or ending your life?
No, I haven't had any thoughts of harming myself or ending my life. Even though everything feels incredibly heavy and hopeless right now, I've never thought about doing anything like that.
You mentioned feeling constantly exhausted; do you feel this loss of energy or fatigue nearly every day, even when you haven't been physically active?

Actually, I think I might have misspoke earlier; I don't really experience daily physical exhaustion or a loss of energy. It's more of a mental heaviness and lack of motivation that keeps me from doing things, rather than feeling physically tired.
